map.D 为单根电缆外径(mm)，N 为电缆根数；填充率按用途取 40%（动力）、50: D is the outer diameter of one cable (mm) and N the number of cables; the fill ratio is taken as 40% (power), 50% (control) and so on according to use. Sizing by the area method guarantees thermal margin and installation space.
map.cable-tray-sizing：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册: cable-tray-sizing: enter the parameters online and the result appears immediately, with no installation and no registration.
map.为什么按面积而不是按根数选型？: Why size by area rather than by the number of cables?
map.动力电缆常取 40%，控制电缆可放宽至 50%；高温或需扩容场合宜更低。: Power cables commonly use 40%, while control cables may be relaxed to 50%; for high temperatures or future expansion, go lower.
map.单根截面积 A₁ = π·D²/4；电缆总截面积 A = A₁·N；所需桥架面积: Single-cable cross-section A₁ = π·D²/4; total cable cross-section A = A₁·N; required tray area A_need = A / fill ratio; pick the smallest size whose width x height >= A_need; actual fill ratio = A /(width x height) x 100%
map.同样根数不同直径占用空间差异大，按面积法能真实反映敷设所需空间。: The same number of cables with different diameters take up very different space, so the area method reflects the space actually needed for the run.
map.填充率取多少合适？: What fill ratio should I use?
map.按填充率选型桥架宽×高规格。: Choose the tray width x height from the fill ratio.
map.按电缆外径与根数计算所需桥架截面积。: Compute the required tray cross-sectional area from the cable outer diameter and the number of cables.
map.校核实际填充率是否满足散热与施工要求。: Check whether the actual fill ratio meets the thermal and installation requirements.
map.：总截面积约 785 mm²，按 40% 填充率需桥架面积约 1964 mm²，: : the total cross-sectional area is about 785 mm², so at a 40% fill ratio a tray area of about 1964 mm² is needed; a 100x50 size is suitable, giving an actual fill ratio of about 15.7%.
map.：电缆根数多、截面大时推荐 300×150 及以上规格，保证散热余量与后期扩容空: : with many or large-section cables, 300x150 or larger is recommended to keep thermal margin and room for later expansion.
